blocks.text: **Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware (CVE-2025-34035); (2) isolate or patch exposed Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router (CVE-2026-103406); (3) isolate or patch exposed Crocoblock JetSearch (CVE-2025-49931); (4) close previously reported Project MONAI MONAI Label, N-able MailAssure, Idunno AntiCsrf and Drupal Core KEV exposure; (5) examine Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware hosts for unexpected child processes and outbound connections.

**CVE-2025-34035 - Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware OS command injection (CVSS 10).** An OS command injection vulnerability exists in EnGenius EnShare Cloud Service version 1.4.11 and earlier. The usbinteract.cgi script fails to properly sanitize user input passed to the path parameter, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to inject arbitrary shell commands. The injected commands are executed with root privileges, leading to full system compromise. Affected releases (NVD): esr300 firmware = 1.1.0.28; esr300 firmware = 1.3.1.42; esr300 firmware = 1.4.0; +22 more. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-135202 - CVE-2026-135202 remote code execution (CVSS 9.8).** Several plugins for WordPress published by WP connect (Orders Sync to Airtable for WooCommerce, Add-On for Contact Form 7 to Notion, WP Sync for Notion – Notion to WordPress, Add-On for Contact Form 7 to Airtable, Add-on Brevo for Gravity Forms, and Air WP Sync – Airtable to WordPress) contain embedded malicious code (a backdoor) in the versions listed. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

EPSS: 2.7% probability / 86th percentile (FIRST EPSS). CISA KEV: Not listed in latest verified baseline. Exploitation: No malicious exploitation confirmed by tracked sources. Public exploit code referenced: 1 unvetted GitHub repository; weaponized exploit not verified. Mitigation: Apply the vendor fix or mitigation; remove untrusted network reachability until patched; place the service behind authentication or a VPN; monitor for exploitation.
Also prioritized: CVE-2026-136404 (CVE-2026-136404, urgent); CVE-2026-136411 (BusyBox, urgent). Details are in the Vulnerability Validation catalog.

CISA added 1 vulnerability to the KEV catalog in the reporting window: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router. The federal remediation deadline is **November 28, 2026**. This deadline applies to covered federal agencies under applicable requirements; it is not a universal private-sector mandate.

**Defensive hunting:** for Engeniustech Esr600 Firmware (CVE-2025-34035), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host; for Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router (CVE-2026-103406), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host; for Crocoblock JetSearch (CVE-2025-49931), review database errors and anomalous queries originating from the application; for JetBooking WordPress plugin (CVE-2026-3496), review database errors and anomalous queries originating from the application.
